paper.title: Design of Internal Contact-induced Multiple Quasi-zero Stiffness using Capped Conical Shells
paper.abstract: However, conventional QZS structures suffer from load sensitivity, limiting their application outside narrow design loads. This study proposes a mass-producible capped conical shell structure that induces internal contact between two distinct nonlinear components to realize a secondary QZS region. This multiple QZS mechanism successfully extends the effective load range by over 200% compared to a single structure. Additionally, its modular design allows simple series connections to flexibly accommodate various target loads. Optimal geometric parameters were derived using a surrogate model based on a nonlinear hyperelastic Finite Element Method (FEM) database. Static compression tests on a 3D-printed TPU prototype experimentally verified the two designed QZS regions. The proposed mechanism is highly promising for vibration isolation in vehicle platforms and precision machinery subject to fluctuating payloads. —TPU 95A Serr FS 250 a ia. v0 2 150 § - 100 50 0 0 2 4 6 8 10 12 Displacement(mm)
